1. thermite-lower/src/lower.rs::emit_string_wrapper — slice gains ens result.data@ == self.data@.subrange(lo as int, hi as int) (the trim spelling); concat gains ens result.data@ == self.data@ + b.data@ (the appended view). The VERIFIED bodies gain subrange-push proof aids mirroring trim (ghost old_out + the subrange =~= push assert; loop content invariants; loop-exit lift).
2. tests/golden/lower/{string_demo,parse_u64}.verus.rs — both embed the wrapper text; updated mechanically (added ens + proof aids only).
3. .design/basis/07-strings.md — REQ-4 prose + table row updated to the strengthened ens.

PROOF SHAPE: verbatim trim subrange-push (07-strings REQ-16). No assume/external_body (R-DEFER-9). No other wrapper method needed transitively.

ORACLES: O-1 slice_id flips L3-fail->L3-pass (verified live: 3v1e under old ens, 4v0e under new). O-2 full workspace test verus-live, 0 failures. O-3 golden diff added-ensures(+proof-aid)-only. O-4 doc-drift exit 0 after commit-2 pin ceremony (the 10 routed lower.rs docs re-pinned claim-neutral; only 07-strings substantive).

COMMITS: (1) thermite-lower: TString slice/concat byte-content ensures (subrange/append) — the #276 prerequisite (#277); (2) the doc-drift pin bumps.
